lessons.name: Numbers and Prices
lessons.description: Count in tens, ask how much things cost and pay at the till.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tens
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each number to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: How much is the bread
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Колко струва хлябът?" means "How much does the bread cost?"

true_false.name: True or false: Sto
true_false.explanation: Correct. Сто is 100, and двеста is 200.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two euro fifty
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кафето струва две __ и петдесет цента.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кафето струва две евро и петдесет цента." means "The coffee costs two euro fifty." Евро never changes its form.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The apples cost
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ябълките струват три евро за килограм." means "The apples cost three euro a kilo." Ябълките is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Skapo
true_false.explanation: "Скъпо" means "expensive". "Cheap" is "евтино".

multiple_choice.name: Match the till phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Pay by card
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да платя с __ вместо в брой?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да платя с карта вместо в брой?" means "Can I pay by card instead of cash?"

true_false.name: True or false: V broi
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Плащам в брой" is "I pay in cash", and "плащам с карта" is "I pay by card".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Your change
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Заповядайте, ето ви __ и касовата бележка.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Заповядайте, ето ви рестото и касовата бележка." means "Here you are, your change and the receipt."

lessons.name: Big Numbers and Sums
lessons.description: Hundreds and thousands, the year, and simple sums out loud.

multiple_choice.name: Match the hundreds
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each number to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Ten thousand euro
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Колата струва десет хиляди евро." means "The car costs ten thousand euro." One is хиляда, more are хиляди.

true_false.name: True or false: Hilyada
true_false.explanation: Correct. 2000 is "две хиляди".

fill_in_the_blank.name: This year
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сега е две хиляди двадесет и __ година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сега е две хиляди двадесет и шеста година." means "It is now the year 2026." A year is an ordinal number, and година is feminine.

fill_in_the_blank.name: One hundred and fifty seats
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В залата има сто и __ места.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В залата има сто и петдесет места." means "There are one hundred and fifty seats in the hall."

true_false.name: True or false: Dvesta
true_false.explanation: "Двеста" is 200. 2000 is "две хиляди".

multiple_choice.name: Match the maths words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English maths word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two plus two
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Две плюс две е __ на четири.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Две плюс две е равно на четири." means "Two plus two equals four."

true_false.name: True or false: Pet po pet
true_false.sentence: In maths, "пет по пет" means "five times five".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Пет по пет е двадесет и пет.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Ten minus three
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Десет минус три е седем." means "Ten minus three is seven."

lessons.name: At the Market: Fruit
lessons.description: Buy fruit by the kilo and describe it.

multiple_choice.name: Match the fruit
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each fruit to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A kilo of apples
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Искам един килограм ябълки за сладкиш." means "I want a kilo of apples for a cake." After a quantity, the noun is plural with no article.

true_false.name: True or false: Grozde
true_false.explanation: Correct. Грозде is a collective noun: "гроздето е сладко".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Sweet cherries
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Черешите са много сладки днес." means "The cherries are very sweet today." Черешите is plural.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Half a kilo
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дайте ми половин килограм круши, моля." means "Give me half a kilo of pears, please." Before a noun, "half" is половин.

true_false.name: True or false: Dinya
true_false.explanation: "Диня" is a watermelon. A lemon is "лимон".

multiple_choice.name: Match more fruit
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each fruit to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Are the peaches fresh
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Прасковите са ли пресни?" means "Are the peaches fresh?" You will also hear "Пресни ли са прасковите?".

true_false.name: True or false: Kaysiya
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian apricot jam, "конфитюр от кайсии", is a classic.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Cheaper than those
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тези ягоди са по-евтини от онези." means "These strawberries are cheaper than those."

lessons.name: At the Market: Vegetables
lessons.description: Vegetables for a salad or a soup, and adjectives that agree with them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the vegetables
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each vegetable to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: White cheese
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За шопска салата ни трябват домати, краставици и __ сирене.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...домати, краставици и бяло сирене" means "...tomatoes, cucumbers and white cheese." Сирене is neuter.

true_false.name: True or false: Luk
true_false.explanation: Correct. Garlic is "чесън", and a spring onion is "зелен лук".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two kilos of potatoes
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купих два килограма картофи за супата." means "I bought two kilos of potatoes for the soup."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Green and sweet
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тези чушки са зелени и сладки." means "These peppers are green and sweet." Чушки is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Krastavitsa
true_false.explanation: "Краставица" is a cucumber. A carrot is "морков".

multiple_choice.name: Match more vegetables
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each vegetable to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Good for your eyes
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Морковите са полезни за очите." means "Carrots are good for your eyes."

true_false.name: True or false: Chesan
true_false.explanation: Correct. Garlic goes into many Bulgarian dishes, from таратор to боб.

fill_in_the_blank.name: How much are the tomatoes
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "По колко са доматите днес?" means "How much are the tomatoes today?" "По колко" asks for a price per unit.

lessons.name: Shops in Town
lessons.description: Where to buy what, and whether a shop is open or closed.

multiple_choice.name: Match the shops
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each shop to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bread from the bakery
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купувам хляб от фурната до нас." means "I buy bread from the bakery near us."

true_false.name: True or false: Apteka
true_false.explanation: Correct. An аптека is a pharmacy.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Open until eight
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Магазинът е отворен до осем вечерта." means "The shop is open until eight in the evening." Магазин is masculine.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Closed all day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В неделя книжарницата е __ цял ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В неделя книжарницата е затворена цял ден." means "On Sunday the bookshop is closed all day." Книжарница is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Mesarnitsa
true_false.explanation: A месарница is a butcher's, where you buy meat. Flowers are sold in a цветарница.

multiple_choice.name: Match the places to shop
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Going shopping
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: В събота ходим на __ за плодове.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "В събота ходим на пазар за плодове." means "On Saturday we go shopping for fruit." "Ходя на пазар" means "to go shopping".

true_false.name: True or false: Mol
true_false.explanation: Correct. It comes from the English word "mall".

fill_in_the_blank.name: A pharmacy nearby
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Извинете, къде има аптека наблизо?" means "Excuse me, where is there a pharmacy nearby?" After "има" the noun usually has no article.

lessons.name: Clothes
lessons.description: Everyday clothes, trying things on and dressing for the weather.

multiple_choice.name: Match the clothes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each item of clothing to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A blue shirt
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Днес нося синя __ и бял панталон.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Днес нося синя риза и бял панталон." means "Today I am wearing a blue shirt and white trousers."

true_false.name: True or false: Roklya
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Нова рокля" is "a new dress".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Try it on
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да __ пробвам това яке?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да го пробвам това яке?" means "May I try this jacket on?" Яке is neuter, so "it" is го.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A warm coat
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През зимата нося топло палто." means "In winter I wear a warm coat." Палто is neuter.

true_false.name: True or false: Pola
true_false.explanation: "Пола" is a skirt. Trousers are "панталон".

multiple_choice.name: Match the accessories
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Comfortable shoes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тези __ са нови и много удобни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тези обувки са нови и много удобни." means "These shoes are new and very comfortable." After "тези" the noun takes no article.

true_false.name: True or false: Rakavitsi
true_false.explanation: Correct. Ръкавици are gloves, from ръка (hand).

fill_in_the_blank.name: Put on a hat
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Студено е, сложи си __ и шал.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Студено е, сложи си шапка и шал." means "It is cold, put on a hat and a scarf."

lessons.name: Colours and Sizes
lessons.description: Describe clothes by colour and size, with adjectives that agree.

multiple_choice.name: Match the colours
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each colour to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A red dress
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Харесвам тази червена рокля." means "I like this red dress." Рокля is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Byal
true_false.explanation: Correct. The forms are бял, бяла, бяло, бели.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What colour
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какъв цвят е колата ти?" means "What colour is your car?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: A bigger size
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имате ли този панталон в __ размер?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имате ли този панталон в по-голям размер?" means "Do you have these trousers in a bigger size?" Размер is masculine.

true_false.name: True or false: Siv
true_false.explanation: "Сив" means "grey". Pink is "розов".

multiple_choice.name: Match the sizes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Blue eyes
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тя има сини очи." means "She has blue eyes." Очи is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Plural adjectives
true_false.sentence: In the plural, Bulgarian adjectives have one form for every gender: червени рокли, червени якета.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The genders only differ in the singular: червен, червена, червено.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Black trousers
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купих си черен панталон за работа." means "I bought black trousers for work." Панталон is masculine and singular in Bulgarian.

multiple_choice.name: Match the transport
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Which tram
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кой трамвай отива до центъра?" means "Which tram goes to the centre?"

true_false.name: True or false: Metro
true_false.sentence: Sofia has an underground railway, the "метро".
true_false.explanation: Correct. Sofia's metro links the airport, the centre and many districts.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Next stop
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Слизам на следващата спирка до пазара." means "I get off at the next stop, by the market." With "следващата" the article is already there.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Buy a ticket first
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трябва да __ билет, преди да се кача.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трябва да купя билет, преди да се кача." means "I have to buy a ticket before I get on."

true_false.name: True or false: Troleybus
true_false.sentence: A "тролейбус" runs on rails like a train.
true_false.explanation: A тролейбус runs on tyres and takes power from overhead wires. A трамвай runs on rails.

multiple_choice.name: Match the travel verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Twenty minutes
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Чакам автобуса вече двадесет минути." means "I have been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes."

true_false.name: True or false: Kachvam se
true_false.sentence: "Качвам се" means "to get on" a tram or a bus.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Качвам се на трамвая" is "I get on the tram".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Is this seat free
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Това място свободно ли е?" means "Is this seat free?" Място is neuter.

multiple_choice.name: Match the directions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English direction to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Go straight on
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вървете направо до светофара." means "Go straight on to the traffic lights."

true_false.name: True or false: Svetofar
true_false.explanation: Correct. "На светофара завийте наляво" means "Turn left at the traffic lights".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Turn right
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На ъгъла завийте надясно." means "At the corner, turn right." Завийте is the polite command.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Not far
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Музеят не е __ оттук, на пет минути е.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Музеят не е далече оттук, на пет минути е." means "The museum is not far from here, it is five minutes away."

true_false.name: True or false: Sreshtu
true_false.explanation: "Срещу" means "opposite". "Next to" is "до".

multiple_choice.name: Match the landmarks
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: To the square
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Извинете, как да стигна до __ „Св. Александър Невски“?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Как да стигна до площад „Св. Александър Невски“?" means "How do I get to St Alexander Nevsky Square?" Before a name the noun takes no article.

true_false.name: True or false: Most
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Лъвов мост" (Lions' Bridge) is a well-known bridge in Sofia.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the corner
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Аптеката е на ъгъла до банката." means "The pharmacy is on the corner by the bank."

lessons.name: Calling a Taxi
lessons.description: Order a taxi, give an address and pay the driver.

multiple_choice.name: Match the taxi words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: To the airport
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Моля, закарайте ме до __ за полета в осем.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, закарайте ме до летището за полета в осем." means "Please take me to the airport for the eight o'clock flight."

true_false.name: True or false: Gara
true_false.explanation: Correct. The bus station is "автогара".

fill_in_the_blank.name: How much will it cost
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Колко ще струва до центъра?" means "How much will it cost to the centre?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Stop here
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Спрете тук, моля." means "Stop here, please." Спрете is the polite command.

true_false.name: True or false: Letishte
true_false.explanation: "Летище" is an airport, from летя (to fly). A port is "пристанище".

multiple_choice.name: Match the taxi phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I will order a taxi
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ще ти __ такси за осем часа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще ти поръчам такси за осем часа." means "I will order you a taxi for eight o'clock."

true_false.name: True or false: Zadrazhte restoto
true_false.explanation: Correct. Рестото is the change you get back.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I have a train to catch
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Моля, карайте по-бързо, бързам за влака." means "Please drive faster, I am hurrying to catch the train."
